blockers: Phase 1e (catalog completion): the 5 previously source-access-blocked catalog rows are now resolved by a direct visual re-check of the user-supplied sourcebook PDFs (Exalted: The Abyssals pp. 201, 210, 224-226; Book of Bone and Ebony pp. 129-130, 134-135), not fabricated. soaring-raptor-prana and striking-snake-grab (both p.201/p.210, verificationState was unreviewed) and iron-countermagic (p.224, verificationState was unreviewed -- its earlier OCR capture was also garbled/inverted in places, corrected in this pass) are now reviewed and promoted as-is. brick-by-brick-solitude and barred-tomb (disposition was unresolved) are now confirmed to have full, legible mechanics text but a genuinely absent printed mote cost -- the source describes each purely as a variant of its base spell (Ringing Hun Rebuke / Denying the Call respectively) without restating a cost, a real authorial omission, not an extraction gap -- so both are promoted with an honestly-null cost rather than an invented number. catalog.promotableEntries/promotedEntries moved 503/500 -> 505/505 (the 2 previously-unresolved spells were not counted in the prior denominator at all; they now are), unresolvedEntries moved 2 -> 0, and catalog.checksum is now a real value computed by scripts/audit-exalted-sources.mjs's new catalogChecksum (FNV-1a hash of the id-sorted entries in abyssal-charms.json + abyssal-necromancy.json -- the family-prefixed catalog files this audit script actually scans; the remaining 172 promotable rows (80 Merits/Flaws, 6 Backgrounds, 86 Sorcery spells) live in catalogs shared across multiple splats and validated once, not per family, so they are not part of this specific hash). Re-run `npm run audit:exalted-sources` after any future edit to abyssal-charms.json/abyssal-necromancy.json to get the new checksum.

Catalog dimension is now fully accounted for at the row level (505 of 505 promotable rows promoted, 0 unresolved), but certifiedAt deliberately stays null and this family stays locked: (1) browserTests remains not-run because Abyssal has no user-facing creation route yet (see definition.tsx's variants) -- there is nothing for an end-to-end browser test to exercise until the family is unlocked, and writing one now would require unlocking it first, which defeats the point of this gate; (2) even once browserTests passes, Phase 6's rule that all five planned families (Lunar/Abyssal/Sidereal/Alchemical/Fair Folk) ship together means no single family's certifiedAt should be set until every family's record independently reaches the same state. Abyssal is otherwise essentially cert-ready: rulesTests/creatorTests/migrationTests all pass and the catalog dimension's row-level work is complete. Phase 6 (browser-test evidence, per-family incremental pass, following Lunar's own precedent) closed the browserTests dimension: tests/e2e/exalted1e-abyssal.spec.ts injects a 'draft'-status Abyssal record directly into IndexedDB (the family stays locked, so the 'Choose Abyssal Exalted' button on /create remains disabled and unused by this spec, exactly as exalted.spec.ts already asserts) and opens it via the character library's real 'Open <name>' button, then exercises the actual production guided-creation wizard (Caste selection, 'Initialize verified Attribute profile', 'Apply derived values'), the Abyssal state panel (Liege/Resonance/Whispers), the real 227-entry Charms catalog and the shared Merits & Flaws catalog's Abyssal-only 'Taint's Warning' Merit, IndexedDB persistence across a reload, and the 320px no-horizontal-scroll requirement, all in a real browser engine. certifiedAt stays null regardless: Phase 6's own rule still requires all five planned families to reach certifiedAt together, and Abyssal's own evidence is only one of the five still needed (Lunar's own evidence closed first).
notes: Exalted: The Abyssals reviewed cover-to-cover for player-facing mechanics (Chapters One through Six), plus the supplements The Book of Bone and Ebony and Savant and Sorcerer (with Book of Three Circles consulted only to resolve the Solar Circle Sorcery access question), plus the cross-splat Exalted Players Guide's universal Merits/Flaws chapter, plus two small sets of universal artifact catalog rows: 6 rows derived from Lunar's verified transcription of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's 'Further Wonders' chapter, and 9 rows freshly transcribed from Savage Seas' 'Artifacts of the Waves' section (8 selectable, 1 reference-only -- Armor of Aquatic Puissance, which the source text explicitly states no Abyssal owns). 684 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/abyssal/inventory/. Core book (287 rows): the character-creation overview, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the full Resonance mechanic (gain/loss/manipulation), the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds, the altered Backgrounds, all 228 Chapter Five Charm rows covering every Ability line for all five Castes, the complete 26-spell necromancy system across all three circles (Shadowlands 9, Labyrinth 9, Void 8), 4 of 5 Crafts of the Dead, and a confirmed absence of Abyssal-specific Merits/Flaws in the core book itself. The corpus-rending-blow prerequisite gap was resolved, unblocking ghost-warding-glyph. Book of Bone and Ebony supplement (177 rows): 80 new necromancy spells, a 69-entry artifact catalog (Wonders of the Dead), 5 named artifacts plus 1 embedded spell from the Creations of Bone chapter, an excluded finding for its Arts of the Dead chapter (ghost Arcanoi, not player Charms), and the chapter's remaining nemissary-crafting/war-machine-construction subsystem plus Armies of the Dead troop-logistics material (24 rows: 5 selectable, 13 reference-only, 5 gm-only, 1 excluded) -- this book is now fully triaged with no remaining resume points. Savant and Sorcerer supplement (125 rows): the complete Chapter Five Terrestrial/Celestial Circle spell catalog (84 selectable spells) plus its own Solar Circle/Circle of Adamant spells (9, marked reference-only since no Abyssal-accessible enabling Charm exists), the 15-entry Sample Hearthstones catalog plus its formation/Theme/Expression framework, 5 Sample Artifacts plus the artifact-creation framework, the Warstriders appendix (framework, all 5 classes including the Abyssal-flavored Royal/soulsteel and Juggernaut/deathknight variants, the Proteus Gauntlet, and a weapon-table summary), and excluded/gm-only findings for Chapter One (Magical Theory, pure lore) and Chapter Four (Practical Summonings, GM-facing demon/elemental summoning framework). Abyssal Solar Circle Sorcery access was investigated via Book of Three Circles Chapter Four and confirmed NOT granted to player characters: its intro sidebar only claims the Abyssal Exalted 'have recently demonstrated the ability' as flavor text, with no enabling Charm or rule anywhere in either book. Exalted Players Guide supplement (80 rows: 40 merits + 40 flaws): derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of that universal chapter's full 88 pg-merit-*/pg-flaw-* rows rather than an independent re-read, filling the confirmed Merits/Flaws gap noted above; 8 of the 88 were skipped as inapplicable to a deathknight Exalt (Prodigy, Terrestrial Bloodline, Past Lives, Legendary Breeding, Limited Forms, Chimera, Known Anathema, Greater Curse), and several included rows carry genuinely Abyssal-specific text from the source (Taint's Warning, Eternal Vow, Death-Taint, Priest, Destiny, Dark Fate, Sun-Seared, Pain Tolerance, Disfigured, Permanent Caste Mark, Throwback, Damaged Artifact) -- see source-manifest.json and the abyssal README for the full derivation writeup. Schema/code phase started: 86 rows are now promoted to real production catalogs (the 6 new deathknight Backgrounds, wired into schema.ts's Backgrounds validation; and 80 of the Exalted Players Guide Merits/Flaws rows, extended additively into the shared dragonblooded-merits-flaws catalog via each entry's appliesTo field, plus 6 new Abyssal-only catalog entries for rows with no prior representation -- Taint's Warning, Eternal Vow (merit and flaw variants), Permanent Caste Mark, Death-Taint, and Throwback). 'abyssal' is now a legal stored sheetType for schema/testing purposes only; it is intentionally still absent from definition.tsx's user-facing variants list, so this remains fully locked in the app pending the remaining catalog dimensions (Charms, Necromancy spells, Artifacts, Hearthstones, Warstriders, the nemissary system) and every other certification dimension. A handful of Chapter Five rows still need a dedicated tree-topology disambiguation pass; brick-by-brick-solitude and barred-tomb (Book of Bone and Ebony necromancy spells, previously marked unresolved for a missing mote cost) were resolved and promoted in Phase 1e (see below) with an honestly-null cost, since the source genuinely never restates one for either variant. Chapter Six's ghost/NPC Arcanoi trees, Chapter Seven's Storytelling material, and the Blood and Salt supplement remain out of scope/untriaged. Locked pending remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families. A final cross-splat supplement-triage pass added 16 rows (684 -> 700) from Exalted: Blood and Salt: a Lintha-connection Character Backgrounds reinterpretation sidebar, a Bluehaven approach-navigation rule, four regional Character Concepts lists, seven new Artifacts (including the Talisman of the Cult of Dukantha, which grants Infernal sorcery access), one new Hearthstone (Jewel of Stability), three mundane equipment items, and two new Terrestrial Circle spells (Song of the Lintha, Water's Ally); the rest of the book's NPC/monster stat-block material was reviewed and confirmed out of scope, and four reprinted artifacts (plus, where applicable, a reprinted Hearthstone and two reprinted/superseded spells) received citation notes on their existing rows rather than new duplicate rows. Phase 1b: 225 of the 227 promotable Chapter Five Charm rows and 103 of the 106 necromancy-spell rows (26 core book + 80 Book of Bone and Ebony) are now promoted to abyssal-charms.json/abyssal-necromancy.json and wired into schema.ts, bringing promotedEntries to 414; excluded were the 2 disposition-unresolved spell rows (brick-by-brick-solitude, barred-tomb) and 3 disposition-selectable-but-unreviewed rows (soaring-raptor-prana, striking-snake-grab, iron-countermagic), all still pending a follow-up close read. promotableEntries introduced (503) as the honest target denominator for the catalog dimension, replacing a prior design that compared promotedEntries against the raw 700-row totalInventoryRows -- that comparison was structurally unsatisfiable, since many rows are free-text-by-design (127 Artifact/Hearthstone/Manse/Warstrider/mundane-equipment rows, matching Solar/Dragon-Blooded precedent) or permanently non-catalogable (65 reference-only/gm-only/excluded/calculated/unresolved rows) or pure Caste-flavor text needing no catalog (5 rows). 503 = 227 Charms + 104 Necromancy spells (103 promoted + 1 still-unreviewed) + 80 Merits/Flaws + 6 Backgrounds + 86 Sorcery spells. That last figure surfaced a genuine gap while computing this: Abyssal's own Charm tree includes Terrestrial Circle Sorcery and Celestial Circle Sorcery as real, source-checked enabling Charms (Daybreak Caste Occult tree, Exalted: The Abyssals p.197 for the Terrestrial one) -- Abyssals get ordinary Sorcery in addition to Necromancy, just not the Solar Circle -- but no matching Sorcery-spell catalog has been promoted yet, so a character who takes that Charm currently has zero legal spells to select. The 86 rows (84 from Savant and Sorcerer's Terrestrial/Celestial spell catalog, 2 from Blood and Salt) are already inventoried but not yet promoted; this is queued as the next follow-up phase alongside the 3 still-unreviewed Charm/spell rows. Phase 1d: closed that gap -- 55 of the 86 Sorcery-spell rows are Terrestrial-circle names already present verbatim in dragonblooded-sorcery.json (reused via the new splat-agnostic sharedSorcerySpellIds alias, no duplicate rows) and the remaining 31 genuinely new Celestial-circle spells were appended to that same file and wired into schema.ts so Abyssal's powers.spells now accepts either a Necromancy or a Sorcery spell id, bringing promotedEntries to 500 (414 + 86). Phase 1d (editor UI): generalized Exalted1eEditor.tsx and its two shared sub-components (ExaltedPowersSection, ExaltedMeritsFlawsSection) from a binary Solar/Dragon-Blooded branch to a three-way branch that also wires up Abyssal (Caste select, a reused Limit field relabeled Resonance, its own Charms/Necromancy/Sorcery catalog with an optional Caste filter, its shared-catalog Merits/Flaws subset with Abyssal cost caps enforced in the UI, and its 16-entry Backgrounds list); this is editor UI, not a catalog dimension, so promotedEntries/promotableEntries/checksum/certifiedAt are unchanged and Abyssal remains fully locked out of definition.tsx's user-facing variants list pending real certification evidence. Phase 1e (catalog completion): the last 5 held-back rows -- soaring-raptor-prana, striking-snake-grab, iron-countermagic (all previously verificationState unreviewed), and brick-by-brick-solitude, barred-tomb (both previously disposition unresolved) -- were resolved by a direct visual re-check of the user-supplied Exalted: The Abyssals and Book of Bone and Ebony PDFs and promoted to abyssal-charms.json/abyssal-necromancy.json, bringing promotedEntries to 505 of 505 promotableEntries with 0 unresolvedEntries. iron-countermagic's mechanics text was also corrected in this pass: its prior OCR capture had inverted/garbled the servitude-bond clause and mangled the higher-circle Onyx/Obsidian tier description. scripts/audit-exalted-sources.mjs gained a real catalogChecksum (FNV-1a hash of the id-sorted entries in this family's own abyssal-charms.json/abyssal-necromancy.json), and catalog.checksum above is that real computed value, not a placeholder -- this is the 'future addition to the script, once there is a catalog to check' flagged in docs/18-exalted1e-splat-release.md's design note. rulesTests, creatorTests, and migrationTests were also brought to pass in this same phase (Charm/spell XP-cost wiring plus new test coverage across exalted-shared-records.test.ts, abyssal-powers-editor.test.tsx, exalted-creation-panel.test.tsx, and exalted1e-abyssal.test.ts). Phase 6's own per-family incremental browser-test pass then closed browserTests too (tests/e2e/exalted1e-abyssal.spec.ts); Abyssal now passes every testable dimension and remains locked solely by Phase 6's all-five-together certifiedAt rule; see blockers above for the full accounting.
